conclusion: WebGPU is qualified on this host for the float32 Optimum graphs and the WebGPU-targeted GenAI int4 export: every compute node runs on WebGPU and only mask shape arithmetic stays on CPU. The int8 Optimum export is not qualified because its quantized matrix products fall back to CPU. The CPU-targeted GenAI export places on WebGPU but does not reproduce the CPU reference there, so it is qualified for CPU only.
